dedupe_keys.name: daiad smart water meter consumption time series 1 007 households alicante 2015 to 2017

description: This dataset was produced for the FP7 project DAIAD by the Athena Research Center and holds hourly smart water meter series for 1,007 household customers of AMAEM, the Alicante water utility, selected at random from about 110,000 meters by their proximity to the project's trial panel. Each series runs from 1 January 2015 to 19 May 2017 and gives, for each measurement, the cumulative volume since installation and the volume since the previous reading: 16,857,056 measurements in all. Coverage is Alicante, Spain. The data are a free download from the HELIX data service under CC BY-SA 4.0. Caveats: the households were chosen by location near the trial panel, not as a representative sample, and data before the trial were uploaded in a single batch. Simulation uses: household demand patterns for demand models, agent-based studies and digital twins of distribution networks. Related records: the DiTEC-WDN hydraulic scenarios (data-ditec-wdn-hydraulic-scenarios).
